name: Gayatri Electrical Services (GES)
description: Government Authorized Electrical Contractor (Est. 2003) and Licensed Lift Contractor in Maharashtra. Specializing in 13 MW turnkey industrial express feeders, 11kV/22kV/33kV HT substation erection & diagnostic testing, HT/LT underground XLPE cable laying & Raychem heat-shrink end terminations/jointing, on-site high-vacuum transformer BDV oil filtration (>60 kV), transformer maintenance & emergency mobile rentals (100 kVA to 2000 kVA+), Torrent Power & MSETCL/MSEDCL liaisoning, CEI PWD Form A/B & D.G. Set Regulation 43 clearances, solar rooftop net-metering liaisoning, licensed lift erection & annual safety renewals, APFC harmonic filter panels, and industrial electrification across Bhiwandi, Kudus, Wada, Thane, and MMR.
